tools.name: wallet_balance

Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /wallet/balance, $0.003 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP

tools.name: pay_check

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "evm-wallet-onchain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wallet_balance, wallet_balance_batch, pay_check, quote_swap, evm_erc20_balance, evm_native_balance, evm_block, evm_transaction, evm_receipt, evm_code, evm_ens, evm_nonce · Private data: wallet_balance, wallet_balance_batch, evm_erc20_balance, evm_ens · Public sink: wallet_balance_batch, evm_ens.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wallet_balance, wallet_balance_batch, pay_check, quote_swap, evm_erc20_balance, evm_native_balance, evm_block, evm_transaction, evm_receipt, evm_code, evm_ens, evm_nonce · Private data: wallet_balance, wallet_balance_batch, evm_erc20_balance, evm_ens · Public sink: wallet_balance_batch, evm_ens

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
